prompt: Why is a carboxylic acid much more acidic than an alcohol?

options.label: The conjugate base (carboxylate) is resonance-stabilized across both oxygens.
The sp² C–O is a stronger inductive donor.
Water solvates COOH better than ROH.

explanation: Carboxylate's negative charge is delocalized over two equivalent oxygens — much more stable than an alkoxide.
